contract.application_relevance: Workers incrementally inspect a body through getReader and use bodyUsed to decide later routing.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: bodyUsed is false before read and true after read/EOF; full bytes [21,22,23].
contract.distinctness: Stream-to-Body state coupling, not H011 text consumption or S-series remote stream behavior.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'acquiring a reader alone does not disturb body');
t.equal(first.done, false, 'nonempty body provides bytes before EOF');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'direct reader consumption is reflected by Body.bodyUsed');
t.deep(all, [21, 22, 23], 'body state tracking does not change payload');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'disturbed state persists at EOF');
contract.hypothesis: A stored bodyUsed flag may remain false when the body is read through its public stream instead of a convenience consumer.
contract.mechanism: Body state derived from ReadableStream disturbance
preconditions: Reviewed exact direct-celld source/build/deployment pins and fresh isolated local store.
Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.

schedule.parallelism: two local body consumers joined with allSettled only in Y220; otherwise sequential

contract.source_observation: Pinned bodyUsed is assigned by convenience methods but CelldBodyStream does not update its owner when a reader disturbs it. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.
contract.title: Reflect direct body-reader disturbance in Response.bodyUsed
trace: Construct a three-byte response and acquire a tracked reader.
Assert acquiring alone leaves bodyUsed false.
Read once, assert nonempty data and bodyUsed true, then bounded-drain and verify bytes and persistent disturbed state.
Cancel/release tracked reader on every exit.
